answer:
The average monthly rainfall in Mathborough in 2003 was \(41.5 \text{ mm}\). In 2004, the average monthly rainfall was \(2 \text{ mm}\) more than in 2003, which is calculated as follows:

\[
41.5 \text{ mm} + 2 \text{ mm} = 43.5 \text{ mm}
\]

To find the total amount of rain that fell in Mathborough in 2004, we multiply the average monthly rainfall by 12 (the number of months in a year):

\[
43.5 \text{ mm/month} \times 12 \text{ months} = 522 \text{ mm}
\]

Thus, the total amount of rain that fell in Mathborough in 2004 was \(\boxed{522}\) mm.
